description: This file defines the interface for an object ID set API, including data structures, function prototypes for managing a set of object IDs with hash-based operations, and iteration utilities.

methods.name: oidset_init
methods.description: Initializes an oidset structure, optionally preallocating space.

methods.name: oidset_contains
methods.description: Checks if a specific object ID is in the set.

methods.name: oidset_equal
methods.description: Checks if two oidsets contain the same object IDs.

methods.name: oidset_insert
methods.description: Inserts an object ID into the set, making a copy.

methods.name: oidset_insert_from_set
methods.description: Inserts all object IDs from one set into another.

methods.name: oidset_remove
methods.description: Removes an object ID from the set.

methods.name: oidset_size
methods.description: Returns the number of object IDs in the set.

methods.name: oidset_clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the set.

methods.name: oidset_parse_file
methods.description: Loads object IDs from a file into the set.

methods.name: oidset_parse_file_carefully
methods.description: Loads object IDs from a file with a callback for custom processing.

methods.name: oidset_iter_init
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for the set.

methods.name: oidset_iter_next
methods.description: Advances the iterator and returns the next object ID.

methods.name: oidset_iter_first
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the first element and returns it.
